On a regular $b$-ary tree, reconstruction holds when $b\lambda^2>1$; on an observed Poisson Galton–Watson tree of mean $d$, it holds when $d\lambda^2>1$. In each case the root-estimation advantage converges to a positive limit, with the Poisson advantage averaged over trees and spins.” “The selected statements cover reconstruction above the Kesten–Stigum threshold. Non-reconstruction at or below the threshold and the stochastic-block-model consequences in the paper are outside them.” Quoted, not judged: AMVO has not compared this Lean statement with the family's claims or with the manuscripts.
